# Portfolio Visualizer

> > A comprehensive portfolio analysis platform offering backtesting, optimization, and Monte Carlo simulation tools for investors to test strategies and achieve financial goals.

Portfolio Visualizer provides institutional-grade portfolio analysis tools including backtesting engines, factor regression analysis using Fama-French models, and dynamic asset allocation optimization. The platform supports analysis of ETFs, mutual funds, and custom portfolios with historical performance data and advanced quantitative methods.

## Key Topics

- Backtesting
- Portfolio Optimization
- Asset Allocation
- Monte Carlo Simulation
- Fama-French Factor Analysis
- Efficient Frontier
- Performance Attribution
- Tactical Allocation
- Dynamic Allocation
- ETF Analysis
- Mutual Fund Analysis
- Regression Analysis
- Black-Litterman Model
- Market Dashboard
- Financial Goals Planning

## Core Analysis Tools

- [Portfolio Visualizer](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com): Homepage with portfolio analysis, backtesting, and optimization tools
- [Portfolio Visualizer Analysis Tools](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/analysis): Main portfolio analysis tools for backtesting and factor regression analysis
- [Financial Goals](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/financial-goals): Monte Carlo simulation tool for testing portfolio growth against financial goals
- [Efficient Frontier](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/efficient-frontier): Calculate and plot efficient frontier for asset allocation optimization
- [Backtest Dynamic Allocation](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/backtest-dynamic-allocation): Backtest dynamic asset allocation with historical trades and weights

## Asset Allocation & Optimization

- [Test Tactical Allocation Models](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/tactical-asset-allocation-model): Test tactical allocation models using moving averages and momentum strategies
- [Black-Litterman Asset Allocation Model](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/black-litterman-model): Black-Litterman portfolio optimization model with mean-variance analysis
- [Match Factor Exposure](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/match-factor-exposure): Match factor exposure using asset combinations with Fama-French factors

## Factor Analysis & Performance

- [Factor Regression Analysis](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/factor-analysis): Fama-French and Carhart factor model regression for ETFs and funds
- [Mutual Fund and ETF Factor Regressions](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/etf-and-mutual-fund-factor-regressions): Factor regression table for mutual funds and ETFs using Fama-French
- [Mutual Fund and ETF Factor Performance Attribution](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/factor-performance-attribution): Factor performance attribution table for mutual funds and ETFs
- [Fund Performance](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/fund-performance): Analyze mutual fund and ETF performance with benchmark comparison
- [Manager Performance Analysis](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/manager-performance): Analyze manager performance using factor models and regression analysis

## Market Data & Monitoring

- [Market Dashboard](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/markets): Market performance dashboard with regional and economic indicator data

## Documentation & Resources

- [Portfolio Visualizer Documentation](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/faq): Frequently asked questions covering backtesting and Monte Carlo features
- [Gallery of Examples](https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/examples): Gallery of portfolio backtesting and analysis examples with Vanguard funds
